scope._comment: Hand-maintained. Says WHAT the PDC integration consists of. The installer's Discover/Export methods fetch this file from the repo; deploy/tools/pdc_manifest.rb reads it locally. deploy/pdc-manifest.json is generated from an export and must not be hand-edited.

scope._stencil_profile_keys: Stencil settings holding UserProfile ids. Masked when hashing (ids differ per instance); checked against the deploy model's pdc_staff_profile instead.
scope._required_stencil_fields: Native fields the PDC code reads from the form. Every stencil that holds `with_element` must also have this field (an attribute element) somewhere on it, usually hidden. The account question's proxy dropdown reads and writes grant_request[pdc_account_exists].
scope._element_required_config: Settings every PDC stencil element needs. allow_script lets its JavaScript (and onload handlers) run; strip_html would remove its markup. Fluxx stores these as true/"1"/"0"; any on/off form is accepted.
scope._stencil_option_ids: Dropdown option ids that the repo's model forms use in show/hide conditions, as they are on TRN (where the forms were exported). Install swaps them for the same options' ids on the target instance, and both sides of Validate compare these conditions by option name instead of id.

scope._stencil_field_templates: How Install adds a native field the PDC code reads, copied from TRN's stencil 45712 (2026-10-19). visible_form only: the field is on the form for the PDC component's account question to read and write, and not shown in the read-only view.

scope._placement: Where Install adds PDC elements that aren't on a form yet, in this order, inside a group with group_label at the bottom of the form: interactive (the edit and the read-only component) to the forms of each theme chosen in Grant Request Themes, dashboard to the first GenericTemplate on the PDC Grantee Profile's dashboard. Admins move them afterwards.

placement.group_label: Contribute to the Philanthropy Data Commons (PDC)

scope._stencil_element_visibility: An element's optional visibility says which views it must be in (true) or out of (false): visible_form is the edit view, visible_show the detail view. The interactive component is edit-only and the read-only one detail-only, so a grantee sees exactly one of them. Install sets these on every copy of the element; Validate reports a copy that differs as CONFIG_DIFFERS.
